  1. 11-08-2026 06:11 AM
    Hi, Square and dev team, how are you? I hope you’re doing well.

    I’d like to share some feedback about the Astrologian class here. I’ve been leveling it up, and I think there’s room for improvement with this class.

    First of all, what makes the class fun to play, in my opinion, are the skill effects, the theme, and the fact that it gives me an AoE option with Gravity in DG, using the Lightspeedy skill. That’s what’s kept me playing the class so far, but I’d like to offer a few suggestions.

    01 - Astro is by far the most stressful healer to play, in my opinion. Mainly because of the unique mechanics we have with the cards. Although this is an iconic feature of the class, the logistics of using the buffs while keeping the party alive can sometimes get complicated. They were pretty annoying to learn at first, but even once you figure out what each one does and get the hang of them, they still tend to be a real hassle most of the time.

    Sugestion - Instead of using each card on a single character, I suggest changing the mechanic so that we can only draw one random card. And make the buff from that card apply to the entire party for 30 seconds. This would make the mechanic more powerful and reduce the stress of organizing these cards for each specific situation in the game.

    2 - As a Regen healer, I think the duration of the active buff is too short when it comes to the Aspect of Benefic and Aspect of Helios skills. 15 seconds go by way too fast, and you’ll always have to keep reapplying them to keep the party alive. I feel that other healers who just cast a single regen spell on the tank are much more effective than an Astro with two regen casting on the same tank. That’s because other classes have plenty of other ways to mitigate damage or heal, while Astro relies heavily on this mechanic, with just one or two healing skills to spam.

    Sugestion - Make the Regen from Aspect benefic and Aspect Helios to be 20 seconds cdr. Is a small buff but it will make the class overall better to perform.

    3 - Since Astro is so focused on regen, I miss having raw healing skills. Since there are plenty of Sage and White Mages, adding one or two of these skills could reduce the reliance on regen and open up opportunities in emergencies.

    4 - The Synastry skill is a cool concept, but I think it’s been pretty much overlooked in the class. Reducing the cooldown to 30 seconds would make it more viable to use. It would lessen the reliance on regen alone and enable better plays in emergencies. Or you could simply rework it—I’d honestly be happier with a new raw healing skill to replace it.

    Thats all my sugestion! Thank you so much!
